Question 4
?

Which integral expression gives the arc length of the curve g(t)=⟨tsin⁡t,2−tcos⁡t⟩ from t=0 to t=π?

a
 ∫0π2(sin⁡t+tcos⁡t)dt
b
 ∫0π1+t2dt
c
 ∫0π2+t2dt
d
 ∫0π1+2t2dt
e
 ∫0πt2+2tsin⁡2tdt
